title: Agentao: A Governed Local-First Runtime for Tool-Using LLM Agents
description:
arXiv:2608.13574v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate as execution systems that invoke tools, modify local state, use persistent memory, and interact with external protocols. These capabilities make agents useful, but they also introduce risks related to over-privileged actions, weak auditability, prompt injection, tool poisoning, and uncontrolled side effects.
